faq.q: Can I buy a standard component without a development project?
faq.a: Yes. Standard components and repeat purchases are a core part of Komponia. Start with a part number, datasheet or application requirement. We clarify the suitable configuration, quantities and delivery conditions.

faq.q: Do you support OEMs developing their own equipment?
faq.a: Yes. We support manufacturers integrating components or assemblies into their own devices, machines and systems. The scope can include selection, custom versions, in-house CAD, prototypes, agreed checks and series supply.

faq.q: Do I need a finished CAD drawing to get started?
faq.a: No. A sample, sketch, part number or application description can start the discussion. We clarify the required function and interfaces, then define the technical work needed. CAD drawings and sketches can be prepared in-house.

Our own Lab supports agreed dimensional and functional checks and batch sampling. The features, inspection method, sample size, records and release responsibilities are defined for the component. Specialist testing and certification requirements are clarified separately.

faq.q: Is the accompanying support charged separately?
faq.a: The accompanying technical, sourcing, quality and logistics process is included in the agreed supply business without a separate process surcharge. Your offer defines the included scope. Work beyond that scope, such as additional development, tooling or external certification, is agreed separately.

faq.q: How does dynamic safety stock work?
faq.a: Safety stock is adjusted to the agreed demand and supply situation. Together we define the data, review rhythm, stock limits, financing and acceptance terms. It aims to reduce shortages; it does not guarantee uninterrupted production.

faq.q: Can you help with discontinued parts or a second source?
faq.a: We assess potential replacement routes and additional sources against your application. Technical differences, shared supply dependencies, required samples and approval steps remain part of the evaluation before a change.
